page.overview:
Who is Abner Krill?

He was invited to Maxie Zeus's wedding cruise and got into a fight with The Eraser before being arrested.

He was subsequently incarcerated at Belle Reve and and implanted with a nano-bomb so he could be used by the Suicide Squad.

During the events of DC K.O. Barbara Gordon (Prime Earth) and Raymond Palmer (Prime Earth) attempted to stop him from robbing a bank but were unsuccessful
